# Optional m0.23 bridge uses the genuine existing guest ReadableStream.
option(NODE_COMPAT_CLASSIC_STREAMS_TOWEB "Enable bounded Readable.toWeb byte bridge" OFF)
if(NODE_COMPAT_CLASSIC_STREAMS_TOWEB AND NOT CMAKE_SCRIPT_MODE_FILE)
    if(NOT NODE_COMPAT_CLASSIC_STREAMS OR NOT TARGET builtin_node_compat OR NOT TARGET builtin_web_streams)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "NODE_COMPAT_CLASSIC_STREAMS_TOWEB requires CLASSIC_STREAMS and native web streams")
    endif()
    target_compile_definitions(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE NODE_COMPAT_CLASSIC_STREAMS_TOWEB=1)
    # Earlier add_builtin(web/streams) declaration provides initialization order;
    # this link/dependency is not itself an initializer topology assertion.
    add_dependencies(builtin_node_compat builtin_web_streams)
    target_link_libraries(builtin_node_compat PRIVATE builtin_web_streams)
endif()
